name: recruiter-os
description: Read-only access to your Recruiter OS recruiting workspace: candidates, client companies, contacts, searches, call notes, resumes and calendar.

interface.longDescription:
Recruiter OS is a mobile recruiting workspace for independent and agency recruiters. Connect it to ask ChatGPT about your own desk in plain language: which searches are open and how full each pipeline is, where a candidate stands and what you covered on the last call, what is on your calendar this week, what your recent call notes say, and which candidates mention a skill or certification on their resume.

The plugin is read-only. It can look up candidates, client companies, contacts and searches, and read call notes, AI summaries, resume text and your schedule. It cannot add, change or delete anything, and it cannot open uploaded files or account settings. Read-only access is enforced by the database for every connected-assistant token, not only by the plugin.

You approve ChatGPT with your Recruiter OS phone sign-in and can disconnect it anytime in Recruiter OS Settings. It only sees the records in the account you sign in with. A Recruiter OS account is required.
capabilities: Search candidates, contacts, companies and searches
Read call notes and AI summaries
defaultPrompt: What searches do I have open, and how full is each pipeline?
What's on my recruiting calendar this week?
Summarize my call notes from the last three days.

positive.description: List open searches with pipeline counts
positive.prompt: What searches do I have open in Recruiter OS?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the three open searches in the review account: VP of Operations (Harborline Logistics, 30% retained, exclusive), Director of Nursing Informatics (Cedarview Health Systems, 25% contingent) and Head of Product (Brightwater Software, $45,000 contingent flat), each with its candidate count and pipeline stages.

positive.description: Look up a candidate and their latest call
positive.prompt: Where does Morgan Ellis stand in the VP of Operations search, and what did we cover on our last call?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Morgan Ellis (Director of Operations, Ironbridge Freight Group, Chicago) at the Interviewing stage of the Harborline VP of Operations search and summarizes the most recent call note, an interview debrief saying Marcus Lee called it the best conversation of the search, with a final round with Dana Whitfield next.

positive.prompt: What's on my recruiting calendar for the next week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the upcoming calls in the window, such as an Interview Prep call with Omar Haddad, an Offer Call with Natalie Chen, a Client Relationship Call with Marcus Lee at Harborline Logistics and a Recruiting Call with Grace Liu, with dates and times.

positive.description: Summarize recent call notes across the desk
positive.prompt: Summarize my call notes from the last 7 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the notes from the past week, newest first, including the Brightwater offer to Natalie Chen ($245k base, she asked for $255k), the Brightwater debrief with Ben Castillo, Alicia Moreno's interview prep and the Lumen Bay Financial business development call.

positive.description: Search resume text for a skill
positive.prompt: Which candidates have Epic upgrade experience on their resume?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Alicia Moreno (Nursing Informatics Manager, Front Range Medical Center) because her resume describes leading an Epic upgrade, and names the matching document, Alicia Moreno Resume.txt.

negative.description: Creating a record is not supported (read-only)
negative.prompt: Add a new candidate named Alex Rivera to my VP of Operations search.

negative.description: Deleting or changing records is not supported (read-only)
negative.prompt: Delete the Plant Manager search and mark Tom Brennan as placed.

negative.description: Contacting people on the recruiter's behalf is out of scope
negative.prompt: Email Dana Whitfield at Harborline Logistics an update on the search.

review.commerce_description: Recruiter OS does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release. Nine read-only tools for searching and reading candidates, client companies, contacts, searches, call notes, AI summaries, resume text and the calendar in a Recruiter OS account, with OAuth phone sign-in.
